newsitem.title: JAPAN: DOLLAR SEEN STUCK IN TIGHT RANGE IN ASIA.
newsitem.headline: DOLLAR SEEN STUCK IN TIGHT RANGE IN ASIA.

text.p: The dollar is expected to be stuck in a narrow range above 116 yen in Asian trade on Wednesday amid a lack of fresh trading incentives and ahead of the release of U.S. inflation data later in the day, dealers said.

The dollar's downside is likely to be solid near 116 yen on possible purchases by investors and importers, but buying energy is expected to wane after a fall in U.S. stocks overnight to keep the dollar top-heavy, they said.
Dealers said trade will be quiet in Tokyo with many traders on summer holidays. But a city bank dealer said thin trade may exaggerate moves by relatively active participants.
